title: One Character, Two Courtesies
label: ch:zh-xiexie
canDo: I can write the speech radical 讠 and the twelve-stroke 谢, thank someone with 谢谢, answer thanks with 不谢, and predict from the rule alone that 不 rises before 谢 because 谢 is a falling tone.

payoff.summary: A whole courtesy exchange bought with one new character -- doubled for the thanks, negated for the reply -- and the first place the reader predicts a tone change from a rule rather than being told how a word sounds.
